correctness.rationale: Complete direct 5,949-face enumeration and exact mod-two boundary ranks force rational H3 dimension 46 with no other positive rational homology. Exact signed Lefschetz traces from all faces match a distinct orbit-selection calculation for 22 representatives, and 1,296 group-element traces are constant on conjugacy classes. Wreath-product induced character formula gives integral inner products one for exactly seven irreducibles and zero for all 15 other labels; dimensions 8+12+6+1+12+6+1=46, character norm squared seven, full invariants zero. Source is executable standard-library-only verification of finite exact computations. No infinite-family claim is made.

The strongest general equivariant Rips paper covers binary not ternary cubes. Exact aliases and all known 22-class parameters compared via actual published papers and public research search; no covering module classification found; independent indexing gap remains a genuine risk.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent equivariant representation classification could exist outside indexed web and scholarly-result searches.
Symbolic proof could be simplified or subsumed by a presently unidentified general ternary Hamming theorem, although the checked binary-equivariant paper does not cover it.

value.rationale: The canonical 27-point Hamming cube is the smallest fully symmetric three-factor ternary graph-product case with an established 46-sphere homotopy type. Complete action of all 1,296 isometries, 22 class traces, seven multiplicity-free rational irreducibles, and the absence of global invariants resolve structural symmetry data not inferable from sphere counts. The one-dimensional normal-subgroup invariant line carrying coordinate-permutation sign is a meaningful distinction. The exact finite computation is motivated by symmetry-refinement of published topology, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
